import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import linregress
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load data from CSV files
quench_data = pd.read_csv('quench_thermo.csv')
equil_data = pd.read_csv('equilibration_thermo.csv')

# Combine datasets
combined_data = pd.concat([quench_data, equil_data])

# Filter data up to 2600 K
filtered_data = combined_data[combined_data['Temp'] <= 2600]

# Fit two linear regimes
# High-temperature regime (supercooled liquid)
high_temp_data = filtered_data[filtered_data['Temp'] > 1000]
high_slope, high_intercept, _, _, _ = linregress(high_temp_data['Temp'], high_temp_data['Density'])

# Low-temperature regime (glassy)
low_temp_data = filtered_data[filtered_data['Temp'] <= 1000]
low_slope, low_intercept, _, _, _ = linregress(low_temp_data['Temp'], low_temp_data['Density'])

# Calculate intersection point (Tg)
Tg = (low_intercept - high_intercept) / (high_slope - low_slope)

# Plot for visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(filtered_data['Temp'], filtered_data['Density'], 'o', label='Data')
plt.plot(filtered_data['Temp'], high_slope * filtered_data['Temp'] + high_intercept, '-', label='High Temp Fit')
plt.plot(filtered_data['Temp'], low_slope * filtered_data['Temp'] + low_intercept, '-', label='Low Temp Fit')
plt.axvline(Tg, color='r', linestyle='--', label=f'Tg = {Tg:.2f} K')
plt.xlabel('Temperature (K)')
plt.ylabel('Density (g/cm^3)')
plt.legend()
plt.title('Density-Temperature Curve with Tg')
plt.savefig('density_temperature_plot.png')
plt.show()

# Output Tg
print(f'{Tg:.2f}')

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import linregress
import sys

def find_intersection(x1, y1, x2, y2):
    slope1, intercept1, _, _, _ = linregress(x1, y1)
    slope2, intercept2, _, _, _ = linregress(x2, y2)
    x_intersect = (intercept2 - intercept1) / (slope1 - slope2)
    return x_intersect

def main(quench_file, equilibration_file, max_temp):
    quench_data = pd.read_csv(quench_file)
    equilibration_data = pd.read_csv(equilibration_file)
    combined_data = pd.concat([quench_data, equilibration_data])
    filtered_data = combined_data[combined_data['Temp'] <= float(max_temp)]
    high_temp_data = filtered_data[filtered_data['Temp'] > 1000]
    low_temp_data = filtered_data[filtered_data['Temp'] <= 1000]
    Tg = find_intersection(high_temp_data['Temp'], high_temp_data['Density'], low_temp_data['Temp'], low_temp_data['Density'])
    print(f'{Tg:.2f}')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
